evidence_items.explanation: This benchmark documents errors by both models and humans in its tested setting. It neither tests an effect of human fallibility on model limitations nor decides whether those limitations are excusable; it also predates the post's current-model context.

unresolved_gaps: There is no specified measurable meaning of takes away from.
No intervention connects the fact of human error to a proposed repair of LLM limitations.
